description: Regenerate the workspace's conformetry generator plugin from the conformetry configuration.

configuration.description: Path to the conformetry configuration file, relative to the workspace root. Falls back to the configurationPath option of the @conformetry/nx plugin in nx.json.

outputPath.description: Directory the generator plugin is emitted into.

packageName.description: Package name the emitted plugin is addressed by in `nx g <name>:<generator>`.

title: Conformetry sync
